metadata.description: Agent skills for reputation.ru — Russian court practice research and contract review (counterparty checks, risks, redlines, PDF conclusion) via MCP or REST.

plugins.name: courts
plugins.description: reputation.ru court practice for coding agents: fast case search, asynchronous deep analysis, and document-text retrieval across Russian arbitration (арбитраж), general-jurisdiction (СОЮ), and Supreme Court (ВС РФ) cases — powered by the reputation MCP server with a REST fallback.

plugins.name: contracts
plugins.description: Contract review under Russian law (проверка договора) for lawyers: counterparty and signatory checks via reputation.ru get_risk_report, risks for the chosen side, clause redlines, protocol of disagreements, norms and court practice, PDF conclusion. Reputation MCP, API key via REPUTATION_API_KEY.
